purpose: Remove old-model, hard-boundary, and Mac-to-Spark adapter confounding before selecting the next EnvSolve-Pro mechanism.
claim_scope: Consumed development cases only. This study diagnoses whether previously observed failure mechanisms remain active under the current minimal harness; it cannot support held-out, leaderboard, generalization, or SOTA claims.

arms.A-F: One continuous DeepSeek session with unrestricted execution feedback and the existing minimal integrity boundary, without clean replay.
arms.B-FSR: The same session, model, prompt, target image, and minimal boundary, plus repeatedly callable clean replay whose feedback returns to the active session.

fixed_cases.stratum: checkout ownership drift plus deployment-completeness concern
hard-boundary false rejection plus metric-aligned incomplete deployment

execution.pairing: The two arms use the same recorded seed within each case; provider determinism is not assumed.
execution.official_network_retry: At most one evaluator-only retry of the exact submitted script after a recognized infrastructure failure; the model episode is not rerun.

measurements: clean-replay activation, first failure, feedback-conditioned program change, and certification
EnvBench Official Pass@1 after infrastructure censoring
model requests, shell operations, tokens, and wall-clock time as descriptive metrics
deployment-completeness concerns reported separately from Official success
interpretation_rules: If both arms solve an ownership or old hard-boundary case, that historical failure is attributed to the old harness/backend combination and cannot motivate a new EnvSolve-Pro algorithm rule.
A B-FSR-only Official success supports clean replay only when the trajectory contains replay feedback followed by a materially changed program and certification.
Failure before any replay is candidate-formation or search failure, not evidence against replay feedback.

A dependency-download failure repaired inside the active session is algorithm behavior; the same failure after session termination is infrastructure-censored only under the existing recognized signature policy.
One realization per arm is insufficient for an effect-size or success-rate claim; any candidate mechanism selected after this study must receive a separate repeated qualification.
decision: Use the resulting trajectories to remove obsolete failure mechanisms from the design target and identify the earliest repeated active failure. Do not implement or promote a new treatment from a single case-specific repair.
